# AGENT.md — .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE

## Purpose
**Issue Templates** — Standardized templates to guide contributors in submitting bug reports and feature requests.

## Templates
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `bug_report.md` | Template for reporting bugs |
| `feature_request.md` | Template for requesting new features |

## Agent Guidelines
- Keep templates concise and actionable.
- Require reproduction steps for bug reports.
- Include acceptance criteria fields in feature request templates.
